name: Cultist: Void Rage adds 5 points to Shadow of the Void's own damage percent through a native spell mod (#2232)
contract: 681102 is SpellFamilyName 31, effect0 ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107), MiscValue=3 (SPELLMOD_EFFECT1), BasePoints=4 -> CalcValue 5, SpellClassMask [256,0,0]. Shadow of the Void (300277) is SpellFamilyName 31 with SpellFamilyFlags[0]=256 (exact classmask match) and its own effect0 is MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_DONE (79) on the Shadow school, BasePoints=9 -> CalcValue 10 (percent). Player::ApplySpellMod resolves SPELLMOD_EFFECT1 for a flat-type modifier as basevalue+totalflat (Player.cpp ~10322), so querying spell_modifier(300277, op=3, base=10) reflects the actual percent points Shadow of the Void grants once boosted: 10+5=15. No custom C++ required; regression guard for behaviour that already works natively.
